name: Kaduse Medikal
purpose: A medical-equipment brand, starting with stethoscopes, that builds its identity through the relationship with the medical profession rather than product-first selling -- accompanying healthcare workers and students through the choice of important tools in their professional life. Long-term: a medical lifestyle and professional brand for healthcare workers in Turkiye, not limited to a single product category.
audience: Medical students, physicians, interns, nurses, health-department students, and other healthcare professionals in Turkiye, especially those beginning their profession or seeking personalized medical equipment.
